provenance.author: Mosh
provenance.note: An original Mosh recipe built only from Tracktion Engine built-ins already shipped in Mosh. Not derived from, a reconstruction of, or endorsed by any commercial preset.
provenance.rationale: Dry and conservative: clear rumble below the voice, then even out level gently. No EQ, de-essing, saturation, ambience or makeup gain — none is justified without a listening pass. Values are documented in docs/vocal-presets/VALIDATION-2026-10-01.md.
